name: Mountaineer Madness 2023

venue.name: Western Colorado University
venue.details: Ballroom on the second floor of the university center

information: We're excited to welcome competitors to beautiful Gunnison, CO for the first competition held in the city! Please make sure to read all tabs before registering. These tabs include important information regarding your responsibilities as a competitor and are very important! This competition has a 80 competitor limit. Please try to limit your guests that you bring to the competition! Competitions fill quickly, so it is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot. Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first official competition, this video will provide you with most of the information you need.https://youtu.be/dPL3eV-A0ww If this is your first competition, please be present for the competitor tutorial at 8:15 AM. If you are unable to make the competition, please withdraw your registration as soon as possible by emailing the organizing team, to ensure competitors on the waitlist can compete. You will receive a 75 percent refund if you drop before the withdrawal deadline of (6:00pm MDT 9-16-2023) This competition is financially supported by Colorado Cubers!
